statusLegend.implemented: Usable in current web app (may still have audit tasks)
statusLegend.planned: Backlog only, with specified acceptance criteria

features.title: Default arithmetic simulator
acceptance: 120s preset and inverse operations; parity audited against original client 2026-10-17 (docs/PARITY_AUDIT.md, tests/parity.test.js); remaining deviations: strict timer cutoff and PRNG

features.title: Custom training mode
acceptance: Custom min/max operands for both addition and multiplication axes, practice-only

Setup panel exposes per-axis ranges; sub/div derive inversely from the same axes and the UI says so. Validation mirrors the engine bounds (1–10000, min ≤ max, safe integers); a half-filled axis is a clear named error, never a guess. Last-used ranges persist device-locally and prefill. Custom rulesets can never validate as the benchmark, and the benchmark ruleset and scoring stay untouched.

features.title: Standardized benchmark mode
acceptance: Immutable default rules; practice and early termination never count as standard

features.title: Seeded tests and replay
acceptance: Sequence history viewer over recorded sessions; replay launches an unscored practice copy

The viewer lists every recorded question in recorded order with telemetry (answer corrections, wrong attempts, the unfinished final problem flagged as unanswered, engine-1 records shown as accuracy-unknown rather than fabricated-clean). Benchmark sessions are explicitly labeled as replay practice. Played replays untimed, unscored, persisted only as practice sessions with full rules provenance.

features.title: Input optimization
acceptance: Keyboard/auto-answer work plus an optional on-screen keypad and answer sound cues

Keypad and sound toggles persist device-locally and default OFF. The keypad feeds the same answer field and session recordInput path, and cues are cosmetic WebAudio blips emitted after a question is already scored: neither touches timing telemetry, scoring, or the answer rule. Audio failures degrade to silence and can never break a run.

features.title: Offline-first PWA
acceptance: App caches core assets; sessions stored locally and training runs offline after installation

features.title: Per-question telemetry
acceptance: Record operands timing changes and corrections; explicitly label first-key proxy; wrong-prefix, full-wrong-answer, paste and visibility telemetry defined in docs/TELEMETRY.md

Wrong answers persist as values: engine zm-engine-3 stores a bounded per-question wrongAttempts history (Enter submissions and complete wrong values typed, max 4 entries/values capped at 16 chars, counter-deduped repeats) while the scalar counts stay exact; scored questions and benchmark eligibility are untouched

features.title: Operation-specific analysis
acceptance: Counts and median times for all four operations

features.title: Arithmetic heatmaps
acceptance: Accessible interactive heatmap grid per operation with keyboard navigation, sample counts, median latencies, CI, benchmark-only scope, deep links and cell drills

features.title: Difficulty classification
acceptance: Exact tag taxonomy extended additively with harder-shape tags, pinned by computed tests

New tags (double-column-carry with exact columnar carry counting, three-digit-operands, two-by-two, product-1000-plus, multi-digit-quotient, prime/composite-divisor) are hand-computed and property-tested across the benchmark and F02 custom-range operand spaces. The constraint is only-add: a question's tags derive solely from its operands and every pre-extension tag set stays byte-identical, so stored historical events keep their original tags.

features.title: Speed accuracy analysis
acceptance: Entry-quality typology (clean/revision/slip/calculation) on results

Latency-stratified analytics view across standard benchmark runs: per-type rates with counts, operation-adjusted time cost (ratio vs clean entry and seconds lost per run) with median CIs, first-key vs typing split (labeled proxy), per-operation breakdown gated at 3 solves, and Theil-Sen trend of the calculation share (needs 6 runs); practice/drills excluded by default and engine-1 fallback disclosed

features.title: Performance timeline
acceptance: Benchmark-only trajectory, recent median, personal best

features.title: Fatigue analysis
acceptance: Operation-adjusted relative time by quarter of the run with CIs, plus paired second-half vs first-half shift across standard runs (docs/FATIGUE.md)

features.title: Question replay
acceptance: Replay slowest five attempts with original operands outside benchmark

features.title: Statistical confidence
acceptance: Shrinkage and distribution-free median CIs on heatmap cells, operation summaries and recent scores; Sen trend interval; percentile band visualization; sample-size gates throughout

features.title: Automatic bottleneck identification
acceptance: Automatic bottleneck identification at three granularities with sample warnings at every step: operation and tag weaknesses from the historical event stream (diagnose: shrinkage toward the global median, per-candidate count and evidence label, gated at 5 observations), operand-band skill-cell bottlenecks on the F09 heatmap banding (weakestSkillCell/skillRollups: >=3-solve gate, smoothed ratio, CI below 6 observations), and an automatic consensus surfaced by the daily-plan rationale (slowest gated pattern), the weakness gauntlet quota (weakest stable cells) and the merged recommendation list (F38); descriptive diagnosis of recorded history, not a causal or calibrated model

features.title: Intelligent drill generation
acceptance: Skill-cell drills launch from the heatmap cell detail and the due-review queue (Train tab) and run as mode 'drill' with pinned operand ranges, id 'pattern-drill' and an honest explanation; results never upgrade to benchmark (benchmarkEquivalent false, pinned); daily plan surfaces the weakest stable pattern when its data exists; difficulty tiers are F18, cross-operation pattern mixes and efficacy evaluation (F21/F22) are separate features and remain out of scope here

features.title: Adaptive difficulty
acceptance: Pattern drills have three difficulty tiers (Narrow = lower half of each band, Full = the exact cell and the default, Stretch = full cell plus exactly one adjacent band on one axis, capped at the benchmark operand space for the four double-top cells); the tier is chosen across runs from the F19 review record's success streak (0 = Narrow, 1-3 or no usable evidence = Full, >= 4 = Stretch), never mid-run, so one run's generated pool and per-run review stay interpretable; tier-1/2 draws map to exactly the drilled cell and a stretch interleaves exactly its two adjacent cells (both occur in seeded draws); every tier stays practice-only (id 'pattern-drill', benchmarkEquivalent false, benchmark ruleset untouched); explicitly out of scope: in-run difficulty adaptation, cross-operation pattern mixes (the generator draws from one rectangle per operation), calibrated mastery modeling and any efficacy claim (F21/F22)

features.title: Spaced repetition
acceptance: Pure scheduling primitive is deterministic with explicit now; per-skill review records persist in IndexedDB schema v2 (additive store) with capped localStorage fallback, sanitized/versioned imports and v3 export bundle; every completed pattern drill records one review (interrupted or under-3-solve runs record nothing) whose success rule is the nearest-rank speed rule AND at least half the run's in-cell solves carried no recorded wrong attempt (engine-3 wrongAttempts, engine-2 judged from counters, engine-1-era absence counts as accuracy-unknown-clean); a due-review queue on the Train tab prompts at-or-overdue records and launches their cells; the 1-60 day ladder is a heuristic, not a validated model

features.title: Personalized mastery model
acceptance: Transparent smoothed proxy exists with an explicit formula (packages/training/src/impact.js: per-category share and excess, degenerate-input guards, hard +30 cap, impossible paces refused); the pace-to-points basis is calibrated same-data per realized benchmark run (calibrateImpactModel: predicted budget/mean vs the run's own correct-answer count, sample-gated at >= 6 runs, mean absolute error and <= 10% hit share reported); run provenance now records launch surface, emphasized policy and drilled cell on practice runs (training/provenance.js, whitelist-sanitized on import, never touching scoring or benchmark validity) and treatmentOutcomes pairs consecutive valid benchmarks with attributed treatment runs into an observational predicted-vs-observed ledger; still partial: no probabilistic mastery model, per-category validation of the share x excess step not yet automated, no causal validation (M4/F37)

features.title: Score-improvement prioritization
acceptance: Priority inputs are implemented and ranked: candidatePriority (planner.js) plus impactCandidates rows from verified benchmark scope only (cell rows sample-gated with shrunken ratio > 1, op rows stated against the weighted cross-operation median), merged into one evidence-quoted recommendation list (recommendations.js) and compared across three feature-flagged concentration policies (policies.js: summed projected impact, seeded balanced A/B emphasis via assignStrategyTrial, allow-listed flag override, ranking deterministic with explicit tie-breaks); run provenance now tags every Train-launched practice run with the surface that produced it and, for Train-panel drills, the emphasized policy at launch (gauntlet drills/probes plus the finish-with-standard-benchmark hand-off, heatmap drills/flash, due-review queue, academy lesson hand-offs — all re-tagged on 'play again'); treatmentOutcomes computes observational predicted-vs-observed pairs from that ledger on the pre-treatment history prefix; still partial: predicted-versus-observed TRAINING-gain calibration remains diagnostic only — no randomized arms, no holdouts, so comparePolicies still disclaims any claim that one policy beats another (M4/F37)

features.title: Automatic plateau detection
acceptance: Conservative detectPlateau signal (analytics, pinned 12-run split) stays the only *status*; on top of it the daily plan selects deterministically between three pre-named intervention branches from record evidence (packages/training/src/plateau.js plateauBranch): 'gauntlet-rotate' when a stable weak skill-cell pattern exists (>= 8 solves with shrunken ratio > 1), 'method-work' when a diagnosed slow operation/tag (>= 5 solves) exists but no reliable cell does, 'consistency-rest' when nothing is diagnosable; the branch rides the plan as {name, why, actions} with the evidence quoted in 'why', improving or insufficient-data histories get no branch, and the UI labels it a hypothesis to test, not a proven treatment; tests pin branch selection on flat/improving/thin histories with synthetic slow-vs-baseline fixtures; explicit out-of-scope: any causal or efficacy claim — before/after comparisons must pin the same windows, and causal evidence requires the M4 A/B machinery (F37)

features.title: Addition techniques
acceptance: Round-and-compensate and left-to-right cards have machine-checkable plans reproducing each card's example step by step (pinned by tests/guides.test.js, including independent per-step recomputation)
Academy rehearsal runs untimed in three modes - guided (every step), partial (worked steps shown, learner computes the composition), independent (problem only)
Fresh transfer problems per technique come from a seeded RNG shown with the problem (reproducible, pedagogical domain, not a benchmark distribution)
Hand-off launches a 60 s pattern drill on the practiced operand pattern through the existing practice surface; always practice-only
No timed lesson drills, no persistence, no score surface; no claim that lessons raise benchmark scores (F21/F22 evaluates transfer)

features.title: Subtraction techniques
acceptance: Round-minus and complement-to-100 cards have machine-checkable plans pinned to the card examples by tests/guides.test.js; complement keeps the fixed 100 target with non-round two-digit subtrahend
Untimed guided/partial/independent rehearsal plus seeded transfer draws in the Academy
Drill hand-off maps subtraction to the generator's source operands (subtrahend, difference), so a hand-off drill matches the practiced pattern, not the composite display
No timed lesson drills and no efficacy claims; practice runs never enter benchmark metrics

features.title: Multiplication techniques
acceptance: Distributive split, x9, x5, x11 and double-and-halve cards have machine-checkable plans (tests/guides.test.js); x9/x5/x11 domains require the exact fixed factor so swapped operands are rejected, never mis-planned
Untimed guided/partial/independent rehearsal plus seeded transfer draws in the Academy

Drill hand-off puts the 2-12 table factor first (generator operand order); the double-and-halve card is rehearsal-only by design - its fixed 25 anchor never occurs in the benchmark operand space, so no taxonomy cell or drill exists and the UI says so
No timed lesson drills and no efficacy claims; x5 halving works because x10 is always even

features.title: Division techniques
acceptance: All division cards rehearse step by step with checked plans, transfer draws and drills

Inverse-multiplication, factor-the-divisor and estimate cards offer guided/partial/independent rehearsal with exactly checked answers, seeded transfer problems (provenance kept in the UI) and a 60 s drill launch. Out-of-domain operands show an honest message instead of a wrong plan. Rehearsal is untimed, unscored and unsaved.

features.title: Strategy selection training
acceptance: Compare two curated techniques arm-by-arm on matched seeded example sets, no scoring

The strategy duel walks a seeded fixture (addition: round-vs-left-to-right; division: inverse-multiplication-vs-factor) record by the same problems with each arm keeping its own first-try tally per problem, plus a deterministic per-problem recommendation with its stated why. The head-to-head is an honest tiny-n comparison in fixture order, never a significance claim. Operations whose cards do not overlap state why a duel does not exist.

features.title: Interactive worked examples
acceptance: Interactive step prompts with exact feedback in guided, partial and independent modes

Technique cards accept typed answers at each step (guided), at the composition only (partial), or once for the full answer without steps (independent); a wrong entry asks the learner to recompute and never reveals or grades by score. Answers are checked by the exact deterministic guide checker. Seeded new problems transfer the same technique to fresh operands with the seed shown for reproducibility. Untimed and unscored.

features.title: Optional AI math coach
acceptance: Consent-gated verifier for pasted explanations against checked plans; no grading, no network

The coach surface is opt-in (OFF by default, device-local, revocable) and offers the checked local brief for an Academy card plus a verifier for prose pasted from any external tool: every arithmetic claim is recomputed against the card's deterministic plan, claims shown only when all hold, and wrong, invented or unverifiable text is rejected with the exact reason and never rendered as endorsed content. The verifier exposes no answer/score fields. This build has no network transport and stores no keys; payloads reaching for providers are refused.

features.title: Speed intervals
acceptance: 30-second sprint preset (mode 'sprint', always practice); interval sets (packages/training/src/sets.js, F30 close-out): a named, validated composition of several short work bouts run as independent sprint practice sessions separated by manually continued recovery pauses with a monotonic informational rest meter; no engine timing change, benchmark rules untouched by construction, set pacing state deliberately not persisted; the recovery-against-fatigue link quotes the measured second-half slowdown but is stated as an untested hypothesis

features.title: Cognitive automaticity training
acceptance: Automaticity ('flash') drill on any heatmap cell: engine-enforced per-question latency budget (questionBudgetMs, default the shared AUTOMATICITY_MS 2000 line; slow questions record as missedEvents, never scored, next question gets a fresh window), seeded generator wrapped in varyStimulus so no fact repeats back to back (avoids rote sequence recall; degenerate single-fact ranges cap redraws instead of hanging), stage 'flash' pinned so flash runs never write spaced-repetition reviews, benchmark ruleset byte-identical and imported sessions unaffected

features.title: Weakness gauntlet
acceptance: Gauntlet plan (packages/training/src/gauntlet.js) selects at most two skill cells per day that clear the sample gate with shrunken ratio > 1 (weakest first, deterministic, never a sub-gate or fast cell), drills each with the F18 tier ladder on random seeds, probes each family with fresh same-range problems from a day-scoped seed that is never the training seed and a varyStimulus generator, hands off to one standard benchmark; every stage is a practice ruleset (benchmarkEquivalent false, pinned byte-identity of BENCHMARK_RULES) and 'Play again' relaunches the stage; explicit out-of-scope: efficacy claims and in-run adaptation (F21/F22)

features.title: Personal-best ghost racing
acceptance: Optional cumulative pace visualization derived from stored benchmark run (packages/analytics/src/ghost.js, tests/ghost.test.js): buildGhostTrajectory generates cumulative step checkpoints from benchmark events without altering engine timing; ghostScoreAt and compareGhostPace evaluate live/replay pace (delta, ahead/behind/tied status, projected final score) against personal-best benchmark reference; zero benchmark contamination.

features.title: Automatic daily training plans
acceptance: The 15-minute routine regenerates from history on every refresh; what persists is only completion: one record per local day (dayLogKey, 'en-CA' local calendar day) in the schema-v3 dailyPlans IndexedDB store with a capped localStorage fallback (zetamaster-daily-plans-v1), checkboxes bound to that record so ticks survive reloads; the five steps (warmup, targeted, lesson, sprint, reflect) split the exact target minutes via largest-remainder allocation over transparent weights (1/2/1.25/1/1; gauntlet-rotate pushes targeted to 3.2, method-work raises lesson to 1.6), the F22 branch and the weakest-pattern note ride the rationale verbatim, and a coverage meter (skillCoverage) reports how much of the 420-cell taxonomy the history touches plus stable-evidence counts per operation; plan records carry no score fields by design, imports are whitelist-reconstructed (sanitizeImportedDailyPlan recomputes completedMinutes and rejects impossible dates/ids/minutes) and the v3 export bundle wraps sessions, reviews and plans while v2 and legacy bundles still parse; explicit out-of-scope: fitted or 'optimized' allocation (this is transparent weighting, not a learned policy) and any claim that the heuristic lifts benchmark scores

features.title: Long-term progression system
acceptance: Explicit 30→40→50→60→70+ stages guided by rolling median benchmarks (packages/training/src/progression.js, tests/progression.test.js): five milestone tiers (Foundation 0–29, Fluency 30–39, Speed 40–49, Optimization 50–59, Mastery 60–70+) with stage-specific actionable focuses and recommendations; progression evaluated strictly from verified standard benchmarks (gated at >= 3 runs, lower counts establish baseline with runs-remaining guidance), trailing window median, exact points-to-next, percentage progress within stage, and 8-of-10 consistency goal integration for full mastery; practice and drills never alter ladder standing; M3 officially closed.

features.title: Adaptive training volume
acceptance: Monitor signs of slowdown and daily volume load (packages/training/src/volume.js, tests/volume.test.js): analyzeTrainingVolume evaluates practice duration across recent sessions and detects cognitive fatigue via latency slowdown ratio (>= 20% increase between early and late sessions); recommendVolume suggests rest or volume caps when fatigue is observed; fundamental invariant: recommendations never force continued practice (neverForce true, isOptional true, restDayAllowed true, rest days free of shame).

features.title: Progress forecasting
acceptance: Calibrated prediction intervals from longitudinal runs (packages/analytics/src/forecasting.js, tests/forecasting.test.js): forecastProgress uses Theil-Sen robust slope across verified standard benchmarks with rolling-origin cross-validation to estimate empirical prediction error; prediction intervals scale with forward horizon; strict sample-size gate explicitly abstains (abstain true, status "insufficient-data") when fewer than 8 benchmark runs exist to prevent spurious precision and misleading causal claims.

features.title: Progress-based recommendations
acceptance: Recommendations cite the exact evidence that produced them and name specific next actions (F38, extended in M2 slice 6): the daily plan's rationale names the slowest gated skill pattern with its shrunken ratio and solve count and points to its launch points, the plateau branch's 'why' (F22) carries the evidence and its 'actions' render in the Train tab's progress line as a concrete sequence ('next: weakness gauntlet → transfer probe → standard benchmark'), and buildRecommendations (packages/training/src/recommendations.js) fuses due spaced reviews, weakest sample-gated cells, the plateau protocol and one estimated-payoff row into a single deterministic Train-tab list whose items quote their numbers and launch real practice drills, with a seeded policy-emphasis line beneath; every surface degrades gracefully with no data (empty states, coverage 'build evidence first' nudge, no fabricated homework); explicit out-of-scope: efficacy claims for any listed action and calibrated mastery modeling (F20/F21 evaluation remains open)

features.title: Keystroke analysis
acceptance: First-input proxy, corrections, wrong prefixes and bounded per-question input traces (captureTrace flag); wrong submissions and complete typed wrong values persist as a bounded wrongAttempts history (engine zm-engine-3) with an engine test for the wrong-submission state machine (double submission, backspace, restore); no UI toggle yet

features.title: Hardware calibration
acceptance: Independent number-copying interface and keyboard diagnostics (packages/core/src/calibration.js, tests/calibration.test.js): generateCopyTrials creates deterministic digit strings matching typical arithmetic answer profiles (1 to 4 digits); evaluateCopyTrial records typing latency and accuracy; computeHardwareDiagnostics calculates median latency, p10/p90 spread, and ms-per-digit entry rates to isolate hardware/keyboard overhead from cognitive calculation; backward-compatible estimateInputBaseline preserved.

features.title: Response-time distribution modeling
acceptance: Adjusted-distribution histogram beside the slow-tail metrics (robust cutoff, slow share, time lost per run, per-operation p50/p90, costliest stalls): fixed log bins [×0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, ∞) lower-edge-inclusive, exact counts/shares beside bars, ≥2×-typical tail share cross-checked against the shared robust cutoff, Theil–Sen tail-share movement reusing the consistency trend (≥6 runs), gated below 30 adjusted solves with empty/sparse/engine-1 states (docs/FATIGUE.md)
Benchmark isolation preserved: the histogram reads verified standard runs only (scope 'benchmark') and no scoring, eligibility or generator code is touched

features.title: Arithmetic strategy experiments
acceptance: Seeded A/B assignment, balanced item generation, and outcome testing (packages/training/src/experiment.js, tests/experiments.test.js): assignStrategyTrial preserves deterministic parity assignment; createBalancedExperiment produces counterbalanced ABBA items across arithmetic operations with matched difficulty; analyzeExperimentOutcomes measures latency and accuracy differences between strategy arms with a minimum trial gate (>= 3 per arm) and non-causal experimental disclaimers.

features.title: Performance consistency scoring
acceptance: 8-of-10 70+ goal with progress, 8th-best gap, minimum runs-to-goal, rolling median and 10th-90th band chart, Theil-Sen trend; standard benchmarks only (docs/CONSISTENCY.md)

features.title: Ranking system
acceptance: Sustained verified benchmark ranks separated from practice ranks

features.title: Skill-based achievements
acceptance: Grant goals based on correct verified events; avoid rewarding idle screen time

features.title: Global leaderboards
acceptance: Explicit opt-in server verified rankings with abuse and privacy protections

features.title: Challenge sharing
acceptance: Share ruleset+seed via URL; ensure no PII in shared links

features.title: Minimalist keyboard-first design
acceptance: Focused answer entry, responsive layout, optional browser PWA install

features.title: Fractions and decimals
acceptance: Exact rational representation, reduction, mixed fraction/decimal parsing, deterministic arithmetic drill generator, and equivalence checking (packages/quant/src/rational.js, packages/quant/src/fractions.js, tests/rational.test.js, tests/fractions.test.js)

features.title: Probability arithmetic
acceptance: Exact probability arithmetic, combinatorics (nPr, nCr, n!), dice sums, coin flips, cards, and expected value drill generator (packages/quant/src/probability.js, tests/probability.test.js)

features.title: Percentages and finance
acceptance: Percentages, basis points, margin vs markup, simple interest, and Rule of 72 arithmetic generator and evaluator (packages/quant/src/finance.js, tests/finance.test.js)

features.title: Estimation training
acceptance: Range-based numerical estimation training with verified tolerance bounds, percentage error calculation, and step-by-step justification (packages/quant/src/estimation.js, tests/estimation.test.js)

features.title: Running arithmetic
acceptance: Stateful running arithmetic sequence generator with deterministic step-by-step intermediate and final answer validation (packages/quant/src/running.js, tests/running.test.js)

features.title: Historical 80-in-8 training
acceptance: Historical 80-in-8 quant training mode with negative marking (+1 correct, -1 incorrect), format-specific ruleset, and zero benchmark contamination (packages/quant/src/historical.js, tests/historical.test.js)

features.title: Market-making simulations
acceptance: Market-making expected-value quoting simulator with bid/ask spread limits, counterparty flow simulation, PnL settlement, and edge tracking (packages/quant/src/market-making.js, tests/market-making.test.js)
